title: Retry policy change, intermittent 429s
source: Live calls to Token Factory (Nemotron-3.5 Lightning) with injected faults

evidence.claim: Retry policy changed from max_retries 2 to 4 before incident (deploy event)
Baseline had 0 retries for all requests; incident has 45% of requests with retries (36% with 1 retry, 9% with 2 retries)
Within fixed input token stratum (0-500), latency rises with retry count: 0.4s (0-1 retries) -> 2.4s (1-2 retries) -> 6.41s (2-inf retries)
Within fixed concurrency stratum (0-2), same pattern: latency rises with retry count while baseline 0-1 retries stays at 0.4s
Zero-retry requests in incident window have same latency (0.4s) as baseline, ruling out universal provider slowdown or prompt/concurrency changes
Input token distribution unchanged (avg 213 both windows); concurrency unchanged (avg 1 both windows)

rejected_hypotheses.why_rejected: Average input tokens identical (213) in both windows; latency_by_input_size shows similar median latency (0.4s baseline vs 0.47s incident) for the only bucket (0-500 tokens). Stratified latency holding input_tokens fixed shows latency varies with retries, not input size.

Average concurrency identical (1) in both windows; latency_by_concurrency shows similar median (0.4s baseline vs 0.47s incident) for only bucket (0-2). Stratified latency holding concurrency fixed shows latency varies with retries, not concurrency.

Zero-retry requests in incident window have same 0.4s median latency as baseline (call_3, call_4). If provider universally slowed, latency would rise in fixed retry stratum. It does not; only retried requests are slow.

uncertainties: Exact mechanism causing retries (transient errors vs timeouts) not visible in telemetry
Small sample size in incident window (n=11)
recommended_actions: Roll back retry policy change (max_retries 4 -> 2) to stop retry storm
Investigate why requests are failing and triggering retries (provider errors, timeouts, throttling)
Add monitoring for retry rates and retry-induced latency inflation
Consider exponential backoff and jitter in retry policy to reduce contention

hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: retry_storm: retry policy change caused more retries, and retries add latency
hypothesis_tests.result: Within fixed input_tokens (0-500), median latency rises from 0.4s (0-1 retries) to 2.4s (1-2 retries) to 6.41s (2-inf retries) in incident window. Baseline 0-1 retries also 0.4s. Latency moves with retries.
In fixed retries 0-1 stratum, baseline median 0.4s, incident median 0.4s. Latency does NOT move with window when retries held fixed. Provider-side universal slowdown rejected.
